name: t15-m4-13
title: Implant attempted speech (T15): causal GRU-CTC phoneme decoder (M4-13)
task: attempted-speech phoneme decoding, CTC over 39 ARPAbet phonemes + word boundary

input.features: threshold crossings + spike band power of 256 electrodes, as input_features in the dataset files (already z-scored by the dataset)
input.file_note: data_train.hdf5 / data_val.hdf5 / data_test.hdf5 of one session folder t15.YYYY.MM.DD (t15_copyTask_neuralData.zip)
input.session: required: the session name (folder name) selects the per-session day layer

architecture.code: fidetype.decoders.lookahead_gru (training: build_torch_model; this runtime: fidetype.pretrained._gru, NumPy)

licence.weights_status: CC0 1.0 (user decision D11, 2026-11-22). Not released yet: the upload as a GitHub release asset (D10) waits for a final user yes (P14-02, gap 98). Never in the wheel or the git repository
licence.attribution: Data: Card et al., NEJM 2024, Brain-to-Text '25, Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.dncjsxm85 (CC0 1.0)

text_files.eng_tatoeba_6gram_mkn.npz: CC-BY-2.0-FR (built from Tatoeba English sentences; attribution: Sentences from Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org), by the Tatoeba contributors, CC BY 2.0 FR)
text_files.eng_tatoeba_word_counts.json: CC-BY-2.0-FR (word counts of Tatoeba English sentences; same attribution)

training.data: Brain-to-Text '25, participant T15, t15_copyTask_neuralData.zip (Card et al. 2024)
training.split: dataset 'train' trials of all 45 sessions; checkpoint chosen on val_select (even 'val' trials); reported on val_eval (odd 'val' trials, 701)

metrics.name: safe WPM v0.1 (with LLM rescoring, P15-22)
metrics.source: experiments/2026-11-19-p15-22-llm-learned (not this release: this release has no LLM step)

limits: One participant (T15). The day layer exists only for the 45 sessions of the dataset; a new person or session needs calibration.
Offline replay of public recordings; not a user study.
Phoneme output. Words need a lexicon and an LM (guard() builds the word decoder of the committed trust config).

offer_gate.note: P5-33 (plan a7abc11): fitted on the non-LTT val_select items only; withholds an OFFER when the frame-order coherence is below the threshold; never changes a COMMIT

offer_control.rule: P5-31, docs/trust-guarantee.md section 5a: a control passes if null offer rate <= 0.5 x real offer rate, and (null offers <= floor(0.05 n) or one-sided Fisher exact p <= 0.05); real = the LTT items
offer_control.effect: with the P5-33 offer gate (trust.offer_gate, on by default): the guard withholds offers on no-evidence input; commits, config_id and the certified status do not change (54 LTT commits). Without the gate (offer_gate=False): FAIL, uniform 300/300, frame-shuffled 300/300, real 217/271

trust.input: the log_probs (T, 41) of a decode() stream: guard.decide(stream.log_probs)

hosting.notes: no download URL yet; hosting is the user step P14-02 (docs/publishing-checklist.md)
